summary: Frontend-only testing of Smart Excel Reader 'Sheet Library' system. Verified all 9 features from review request. All Home screen features (No Active Sheet, Add File from Drive, Saved Sheets section with count badge, Quick Actions grid) working correctly. Layout tab shows 'No Sheets Saved' empty state. Tab navigation (Home, Filter, Parchi, Inventory, Layout) works correctly.

integration_issues.issue: After Expo restart, frontend correctly shows new design. Prior to restart, old design was cached. Normal behavior for Expo development mode.

issues: Filter and Inventory cards appear grayed out/disabled when no active sheet - good UX design indicating disabled state
Dark theme (#1a1a2e background) provides good contrast for warehouse visualization theme

critical_code_review_comments: store.ts is well-structured with SheetProfile type, CRUD operations, and legacy compatibility functions
data.tsx 'Save to Library' button implementation looks correct with handleSaveToLibrary function
Layout tab correctly filters for layout-type sheets using getLayoutSheets() function
Tab navigation uses Expo Router's Tabs component with 5 main tabs visible in tab bar
